extraction_notes: The supplied KEC datasheet is titled 2N3904S and identifies an epitaxial planar NPN transistor; the extraction target is the exact job MPN 2N3904S-RTK/PS from LCSC C18536.
Revision identity is Revision No. 3 dated 2003-02-25. Electrical characteristics and plots are specified at TA = 25 degC unless a plot or condition states otherwise.

The hFE table provides minimum values at IC = 0.1, 1, 10, 50, and 100 mA with VCE = 1 V, plus a maximum of 300 at IC = 10 mA. Rows marked with an asterisk use the footnoted pulse test: pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.
The VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) rows publish guaranteed bounds, so the minimum and maximum VBE(sat) bounds at IC = 10 mA and IB = 1 mA are preserved as separate saturation entries.

Curve points are direct manual read-offs from usable characteristic plots on pages 3 and 4 at visible grid positions; no interpolation was used. Plot axes were converted from mA and pF to SI units A and F.

The strict BJT schema has no fields for VCBO, VEBO, continuous IC, base current, power dissipation, junction or storage temperature, VBE(on), switching times, or other small-signal h-parameters; those available datasheet fields were not added outside the schema.
omission_reason: The strict BJT extraction schema does not represent the datasheet's VCBO, VEBO, maximum-current, base-current, power, thermal, VBE(on), switching-time, or other small-signal h-parameter rows.
